name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for home restoration?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for home restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for one with proper licensing, insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed restoration projects. Check references, read reviews, and ensure they provide a detailed contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Transparent communication and a clear understanding of your vision are also crucial for a successful partnership.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with good references, a strong portfolio, and clear communication.
